name: Crooked Time
source:
Your love is missing. 

The townsfolk say they saw him go down to the valley, they say time moves differently down there. For some it’s fast, for others slow. It's dangerous in the valley. If he’s down there, in the valley where time is crooked, you should forget about him move on. 

But you love him, so you’ll follow him anywhere.

[From [url=https://abiwatson.itch.io/crooked-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你心爱的人失踪了。

镇民说他们看见他往山谷深处去了，还说那里的时间流速不同。对有些人来说，时间过得很快；对另一些人来说，却很慢。山谷很危险。如果他真的在那儿，在那个时间错乱的山谷里，你最好忘了他，继续生活。

可是你爱他，所以天涯海角都要追随他。

[来源：[url=https://abiwatson.itch.io/crooked-time]Itch.io[/url]]
